description: The account's quality settings (dashboard: Settings > Qualities). Returns {encoding, playback, compression_mode, compression_label, keep_original_files}: encoding = "Conversão de Novos Uploads" (qualities new uploads are converted to); playback = "Reprodução de Todos Vídeos" (qualities the player offers, on every video, when converted in that quality); compression_mode = "Compressão de Novos Uploads", shown as compression_label (size = Econômica, balanced = Equilibrada, quality = Maior qualidade); keep_original_files = "Backup do Arquivo Original de Novos Uploads".
name: panda_get_library_qualities
title: Get Library Qualities
